subject: riotInterceptor
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: corporate riot-control interceptor with a water cannon and neon light bars.
Style: Cyberpunk 2077.

spec.name: Arasaka-style Riot Interceptor RC-9 'Pacifier'
spec.description: A heavy corporate riot-control interceptor: armoured wedge hull, roof-mounted water cannon turret, glowing neon light bars, and chunky wheels, in Cyberpunk 2077 style.
spec.layout: Low, wide armoured wedge vehicle facing +Z. Front: sloped nose with a push-bar bumper, cyan neon strip and twin slit headlights. Middle: hunched armoured cabin with a dark tinted windscreen, side slit windows and a roof light bar (blue/magenta). Roof rear: a rotating water cannon turret on a ring, with a thick barrel pointing +Z, a hose coil and a tank. Rear: a tank module with caution stripes, hazard-yellow trim, tail neon strip. Four chunky wheels with armoured fenders sit on the floor, and the hull sits about 0.35 m above the ground. Style: matte graphite hull with panel seams, hazard-yellow accents, magenta and cyan emissive neon (glow kit), corporate logo decals and Japanese-style katakana labels drawn in SVG, scuffs and grime painted by place (dirt near wheels, light on top).

parts.builds: Main armoured lower hull and wedge nose: loft or frustum boxes from tail to nose with sloped hood, side skirts, fender arches cut around the wheel mounts (arch rims as thin sweeps), under-tray, panelled paint with seams and rivets, hazard-yellow side stripe, graphite paint with grime near the bottom and light on top. Includes the front push-bar bumper with a yellow-black chevron texture, a tow hook, skid plates, and a corporate emblem decal on the hood. Tail plate with rear bumper and exhaust slits.
parts.attaches: Cabin sits on deckTop; wheels meet the arches at the wheel mounts; the turret ring at turretRing; the tail module at tailPlate.

parts.builds: Armoured cabin on the hull deck: sloped, faceted shell with a dark tinted windscreen (SVG decal with cyan HUD reflections), narrow side slit windows with mesh bars, roof armour plate, A-pillar braces, wing mirrors on arms, door seams with handles, a roof light bar (red/blue/magenta emissive segments with glow, lens caps and brackets), a roof antenna cluster and a front headlight pair of slit lamps plus a neon cyan strip across the nose of the cabin, with katakana and 'POLICE-CORP' text decals on the doors.
parts.attaches: Base rests on the hull at deckTop (y 1.4); the front lamps sit at roofFront; the turret is behind it, at turretRing.

parts.builds: Roof water cannon: a lathe ring base at turretRing with rotating armoured housing on the turretYaw joint (ride turretYaw), a pitching cannon assembly on cannonPitch: thick barrel with a flared nozzle, a stack of ribbed bands, a magenta glowing ring near the muzzle, a glowing water-blue core in the nozzle, side pistons, a targeting sensor pod with a red glowing lens, a flexible hose sweep curling from the housing to the tank, and brackets with yellow warning stripes. The barrel points +Z in the rest pose.
parts.attaches: Ring base bolted at turretRing; the hose runs back to the tank module at the rear, and is rooted on the tank's front port at [0, 1.9, -2.0].

parts.builds: Rear water tank module on the rear deck and tail: a horizontal cylinder (lathe) tank with hazard chevron bands, a translucent-looking gauge window glowing cyan with a water level drawn (SVG), filler cap, pipes and valves running to the hose port, side ladders, tail neon magenta strip across the rear plate with red brake-light slits, a license plate decal with fictional corporate text, and a rear spoiler antenna blade. Roof rear rack with spare nozzle canisters.
parts.attaches: Sits on the hull rear deck at y 1.4 behind the cabin; the hose port at [0, 1.9, -2.0] connects to the turret hose; the tail strip meets tailPlate.

parts.builds: Four chunky armoured wheels, radius 0.5, width 0.5, one per wheel joint: rubber tyre (lathe or cylinder, 12 sides) with tread blocks, steel rim with bolts and a cyan neon ring on the outer face, brake disc and caliper visible behind the spokes, dirt paint gradient toward the bottom. Axle stubs and suspension arms (rods and a coil from the kit pattern) connecting to the hull at the axle mounts, mud flaps behind the rear wheels with hazard stripes. Each wheel is centred on its wheel mount with its axle along x.
parts.attaches: Wheel centres at wheelFL/FR/BL/BR mounts; the suspension arms reach in to the hull at axleFront and axleRear.
